push.title: D 2-2 vs FFC Bradar | You: 8.4
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.4. You played like someone who read the playbook twice and highlighted it.

THE GOOD
+ 27 passes (up from your usual 15). You were always available, like a good neighbor.
+ Won 2 of 4 tackles (down from your usual 58%). Clean tackles are free possession, and you handed us plenty.
+ A goal against FFC Bradar. Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it.
+ Man of the Match, your 7th for us. You set the bar, now the rest of us get to chase it.
+ Match rating 8.4, up from your usual 7.3. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.

THE BAD
- No key passes from 27 passes. Little adjustment: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape. Trust the work.
- Shot accuracy 33%, down from your usual 89%. Homework: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
- 2 goals conceded: -0.1. Room to grow.
- Pass accuracy: 74%. Keep pushing; 87%+ is within reach.
- Tackles attempted: 4. Good, not great yet; top-quarter midfielders sit at 6+.

Try this in practice: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.

Last thing, BellyTb1. Believe it, then go do it.

That's how legends start. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 2-2 vs FFC Bradar | You: 8.2
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.2. Like a good casserole, it's not fancy, but everybody's glad it showed up.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ A goal against FFC Bradar, your 6th straight match scoring. You treated that chance like a winning lottery ticket and cashed it.
+ That partnership with BellyTb1 is starting to feel like a habit.
+ Passes attempted 35, up from your usual 25. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ 6th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That doesn't happen by accident.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Simple as pie: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. I've seen you do harder things.
- Missed tackles 6, up from your usual 2. That's not you at your best, and we both know it.
- Giveaways 14, up from your usual 8. Note to self, from me to you.

Practice prescription: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

Stay curious about your game. - Coach Lasso
